territorial_scope.description: Authorizes operation of ADS-equipped commercial motor vehicles in interstate commerce across the United States.

evidence.quote: may be operated in interstate commerce without

summary.short: H.R. 4661 would add 49 U.S.C. § 31140 allowing Level 4 or 5 automated-driving-system commercial motor vehicles to operate in interstate commerce without an on-board or remote human driver. It directs the Secretary of Transportation to issue regulations and address motor carrier rules for such vehicles by September 30, 2027.
summary.long: H.R. 4661, introduced 23 July 2025, would amend title 49, United States Code. Section 2 adds section 31140, under which a commercial motor vehicle equipped with a Level 4 or Level 5 automated driving system (ADS) may operate in interstate commerce without a human driver on board or a remote human driver, and directs the Secretary of Transportation to issue implementing regulations. Section 2 also defines ADS terms by reference to SAE J3016 and states that nothing requires a vehicle to be equipped with an ADS. Section 3 directs the Secretary, by September 30, 2027, to address the applicability of 49 CFR sections 350 through 399 to ADS-equipped commercial motor vehicles, including rules that apply to human drivers. It bars regulations that unduly burden motor carriers operating such vehicles or discriminate against them, and excludes ADS technologies from width calculations under section 31113. Section 4 treats cab-mounted warning beacons as a permissible warning device under 49 CFR 392.22 and 393.95(f). The bill contains no penalty or enforcement provisions. Its title refers to preemption of State laws requiring a human occupant, but the operative text contains no express preemption clause.

notes: Bill as introduced (H.R. 4661, July 23, 2025; referred to House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure). No registry IDs were supplied, so target_instrument_id is empty for all rows. Internal points: Sec. 3(a)(2)(B) refers to an AD2202S-equipped vehicle, apparently a typo for ADS-equipped, quoted as printed. The definition of automated driving system in section 31132(13)(B) covers automation levels 3, 4 and 5, but new section 31140(a) applies only to Level 4 or Level 5 ADS. The new paragraphs (12) to (15) are added at the end of section 31132, but the text does not show the existing paragraph numbering.

thresholds.variable_text: SAE J3016 automation level that an automated driving system must meet to fall within the ADS definition (Levels 3, 4 or 5)
thresholds.value_text: automation levels 3, 4, or 5 under SAE International's J3016
thresholds.measurement: Classification of the system under SAE International J3016 (or later editions adopted by the Secretary); the text does not state who measures it
thresholds.consequence: Only systems meeting the SAE J3016 automation level 3, 4 or 5 definition are included in the definition of automated driving system; systems that provide only assistance to a human driver are excluded.
thresholds.conditions: System must also be capable of performing the entire dynamic driving task on a sustained basis (regardless of operational design domain limits) and must not provide only assistance to a human driver.
